1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff6352|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff6352|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff7071|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3137|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff3205|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff11073|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Killer's Blade
4.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff4008|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff7514|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

5.name: Echoing Vigor
5.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff16362|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

6.name: The Tide King's Gaze
6.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff3748|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff6991|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1431|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Rune of Displacement
2.description:
Devise a discharging rune under an enemy. After |cffffff2|r seconds the rune pulses, pulling in foes between 2 to 10 meters and etching them with scrawled glyphs that deal |cffffff19990|r Magic Damage over |cffffff18|r seconds.

An ally near the initial target can activate the Runebreak synergy, dealing |cffffff12496|r Frost Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

3.name: Inspired Scholarship
3.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff4115|r Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

4.name: Spiked Bone Shield
4.description:
Surround yourself with a whirlwind of bones, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff9306|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds and returns |cffffff95|r% of direct damage absorbed back to the enemy. This ability scales off your Max Health.

An ally near you can activate the Bone Wall synergy, granting the ally and up to |cffffff5|r other allies a damage shield equal to |cffffff35|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff6|r seconds.

5.name: Necrotic Orb
5.description:
Project a globe of annihilation that slowly floats forward for |cffffff10|r seconds, dealing |cffffff1253|r Magic Damage every |cffffff1|r second to nearby enemies. 

An ally near the globe can activate the Combustion synergy, causing the orb to explode for |cffffff10412|r Magic Damage to nearby enemies and restore |cffffff3960|r Magicka or Stamina to the ally, whichever maximum is higher.

6.name: Soul Harvest
6.description:
Ravage an enemy with a spinning attack, dealing |cffffff16351|r Magic Damage and increasing your damage against them by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff8|r seconds.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
